name: Toki no Tabibito
source:
Main character is on the verge of marrying his lover, but one passionate night he loses consciousness and is awakened by his lover crying. The girl runs out and gets in a traffic incident. Protagonist's desire to revive his love is so strong that he gets warped in time.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角即将与恋人结婚，却在一个激情之夜突然失去意识。醒来时，恋人正在哭泣；女孩随后冲出门外，遭遇交通事故。主角想让爱人复生的愿望过于强烈，竟令他穿越了时间。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
